answer: To enter the work pool, a key must sit a night watch with thirteen randomly assigned sentries for eight epochs, locking 2.25 POA the entire time. Each sentry issues a whisper packet on a 17-minute jitter clock; the claimant has 70 seconds to return a signed echo bound to a fresh hardware nonce. A missed window burns a 0.031 POA ember from the bond. Ten confirming sentries write a pass into the public log. Four misses inside 36 hours slash what remains and shelve the key for six epochs. If two keys show lag correlation above 0.82, both bonds are frozen as a shared desk.
